row.evidence: Mindtickle's integrations page says its User APIs support "everything from SCIM-based user sync", and its developer docs list okta (Okta SCIM) and AzureAD (Azure AD SCIM) as user provisioning sources; packages (Readiness, Enable, Transform, LMS) are sold only through an order form.
row.notes: Quote-only: Mindtickle publishes no prices (/pricing returns 404); packages Readiness, Enable, Transform and LMS are bought via order form/demo, so SCIM can only be bought through sales. SCIM endpoint https://admin.mindtickle.com/scim with a JWT issued by Mindtickle Support (from Microsoft's Entra tutorial). Okta OIN app marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (no Group Push). Mindtickle's own SCIM setup guides are behind the help-desk login. A public REST user/group API (api key + secret to 60-minute JWT) covers create, update, search, deactivate and groups; its plan gating is not published. generic=true rests on the Entra tutorial's generic tenant URL + token setup.

endpoints.purpose: Create a user (also used to add a user to groups)
Update a user (updating a deactivated learner reactivates them)
Add or update multiple users (also add multiple users to groups)

rate_limits.text: User and group management APIs: 5 requests/second, 220/minute, 3,000/hour; HTTP 429 with Retry-After when exceeded. Bulk add/update recommended at 500 users per call.

limitations.text: Write operations are asynchronous and return process IDs; acceptance does not mean the change is complete.
Search returns at most 50 records per request.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked (read from page markup); Group Push and Group Linking unchecked. Last updated Aug. 11 2022.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin catalogue blocks bots and Mindtickle's OneLogin guide (if any) is behind the help-desk login.

fallbacks.other_sync: Salesforce-to-Mindtickle user provisioning (integrations page); public REST user API for HRIS/CRM sync.
